extracted.intended_audience: PR professionals, spokespeople, and clients planning a Satellite Media Tour (SMT)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for planning, producing, and delivering b-roll/video to support a Satellite Media Tour so TV producers can preview, cut-in, and air supporting footage. Covers use cases (pitching, advance delivery, hot-roll) and production/packaging best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have related b-roll or video footage
rubrics_metrics.description: When planning a Satellite Media Tour you’ll be asked whether or not you have b-roll or video footage related to the topic, or if the firm can help shoot.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compelling supporting video is an important part of a SMT and should be prepared in advance; firms (e.g., Lyons) can shoot, edit and produce these packages if you do not already have footage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make b-roll compelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Compelling supporting video is an important part of a satellite media tour and is used several different ways.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Invest in footage that clearly illustrates the story and helps producers visualize the segment; low-quality or irrelevant clips reduce pickup and on-air value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use a b-roll package in pitching
rubrics_metrics.description: Pitching: A SMT b-roll package can be used in the pitching process, and provide outlets with an advance visual preview of the topic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When pitching TV, include the visual component because it is key to help visualize the story for producers and increase interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide supporting b-roll to stations in advance and keep it accessible
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide supporting b-roll to stations in advance: Many TV outlets will request the b-roll package in advance, and during their interview time, will cut-in the video footage to enhance the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep your video package housed with an easily accessible and easily shareable link so you are prepared for inevitable last-minute requests; ensure file formats and links are producer-friendly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare for ‘hot-roll’ use during the SMT
rubrics_metrics.description: “Hot-roll”: The morning of your Satellite Media Tour, outlets will confirm if they would like the video package “hot-rolled.” This means the director will cut-away to the b-roll at strategic times during the interview and this is what goes out over the station airwaves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate with your director/producer so they know when and how to cue cut-aways; have final edited clips ready and clearly labeled for quick insertion during live or recorded interviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use professional production when needed (shooting, editing, producing)
rubrics_metrics.description: With full service video production capabilities, Lyons Broadcast PR shoots, edits and produces b-roll packages and supporting video to enhance Satellite Media Tours.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If in-house footage is lacking or low quality, engage professional production to shoot/edit footage to broadcast standards so clips are usable by stations and effective in pitching and hot-roll scenarios.
